body_html:
Secure filing that earns its place in the room. The Newland NL3624LFT two-drawer lateral file pairs a clean, modular silhouette with the practical storage institutional and private offices rely on — front-locking drawers, an anti-tip safety design, and a finished 1" laminate top that works equally well beside a desk or as standalone storage. Part of the Offices To Go Newland desking system, it coordinates effortlessly across private offices, open-plan workspaces, and meeting rooms.

Features

  • Two front-locking drawers for secure document storage
  • Anti-tip feature for safe, stable operation
  • File bars included for letter and legal filing
  • Adjustable floor leveling glides
  • 1" thick thermally fused laminate top and end gables
  • Available in all Newland laminate finishes
  • Ships fully assembled

Specifications

Measuring 36"W x 24"D x 29.6"H and weighing 149 lbs, the NL3624LFT is built from durable thermally fused laminate and carries ANSI/BIFMA plus GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold certification for low-emission indoor air quality. Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group and backed by a 15-year warranty.

Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Canadian dealer (since 1964) based at 296 George St N, Peterborough ON, and an OECM-eligible supplier — Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote below or call 1-800-835-9565 to order.
